content.title: 240 Free Promotional Housing with Commercial Areas
summary: A 33-storey residential tower in Dely Brahim, combining 240 free promotional homes with three commercial levels with a terrace, three basement levels, and three mezzanine parking levels.

The Dely Brahim project represents a new scale for the portfolio: a 33-storey tower with homes from the 3rd to the 33rd floors, eight homes per floor, three commercial levels with a terrace, three basement levels, and three mezzanine parking levels.
description: The project combines housing density with everyday services, placing F3, F4, and F5 homes from the 3rd to the 33rd floors above three commercial levels with a terrace, three basement levels, and three mezzanine parking levels.

Its primary technical challenge is vertical coordination: the structure, lifts, fire safety, ventilation, plumbing, electrical systems, facade openings, and exterior works all require a unified execution sequence.
content.authority: A high-rise, mixed-use tower where residential density, services, and parking are integrated into a single vertical system.
